question: Does direct source-registered transfer of the archived passive Open Knee patellar path remove exact intersections in the pinned MyoSim left source femur/patella meshes over their common sampled, source-range-valid flexion states?
hypothesis: The source-registered Open Knee path will reduce the number of intersecting MyoSim source-mesh pose states and exact triangle pairs relative to the current MyoSim equality path over the fixed common sample set.

method.control: At each selected flexion, use the pinned MyoSim source equality projection and audit its pinned left femur/patella source meshes with the exact-binary64-integer triangle-intersection predicate.
method.treatment: Transfer only Open Knee patella-minus-femur COM and relative-orientation changes from its first accepted observation into the registered MyoSim femoral frame. Add those changes to MyoSim source-equality-projected qpos0 relative COM/orientation and rigidly place the MyoSim source patella mesh for the same flexion; audit against the unchanged pinned MyoSim source femur mesh.
method.registration: Use the exact proper femoral rotation and uniform scale in the pinned oks003 left-registration manifest; do not refit axes, scale, baseline, or poses from intersection results.
method.sample_selection: Use the existing exact-intersection receipt's uniform 0.05-rad sweep samples that pass all projected source/native range checks and whose flexion is within the archived Open Knee accepted range [0.1294684279282639, 89.94454550419701] degrees. Do not add, remove, or refine samples after seeing treatment results.
primary_outcomes: control and treatment exact intersecting triangle-pair counts per sampled state and in total
control and treatment count of states with one or more exact source-mesh intersections
treatment-to-control patella COM displacement and orientation change per state
method.decision_rule: A geometry-only candidate is recorded as clearing the fixed sampled gate only if treatment has zero exact triangle-pair intersections at every selected state. Otherwise record the failed result without tuning or a rerun. Either outcome is exploratory and cannot change the MyoSim source path.
method.preservation: Retain the plan, command, complete per-state results, exact-predicate counts, input hashes, and any failure status in this directory. No source, artifact, or runtime state is modified.
